verdict.rationale: Missive is a hosted SaaS inbox, so headless use means driving it programmatically without the UI. It documents a REST API with endpoints for conversations, drafts, posts, contacts and labels, published rate limits with 429/Retry-After handling, and an official MCP server, so scripts or agents can act on the inbox. However, nothing documents a CLI, a CI integration, or headless/CI usage guidance, and no OpenAPI spec exists (probes returned 404). Missing for 10: official CLI or CI-runner tooling, documented CI/headless automation workflows, OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
